mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and hypokalemia, while hydrocortisone increases potassium wasting and immunosuppression, potentiating renal dysfunction and electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and blood pressure closely; consider using liposomal amphotericin B formulation and maintain aggressive electrolyte replacement.
